x: At two miles, with Maynard(H.H.H.) leading from Eldon and Knight, Pat was 15th, John 46th and our sixth scoring man in the nineties. At six miles, Eldon had established a substantial lead from Knight and Sando with Maynard 4th.
The ever improving Peckings soon regained this, but stood no chance when Eldon came storming past, and had to be content with seventh place.
For besides the oppresive heat he also had to contend with Messrs. Pirie, Hyman, Eldon & Co. Pat ran, relatively, as well as anybody in the field to record 14:14, but was outside the first six.

The race was held at Cardiff and Eldon, Sando and Mimoun entered the final straight together. Mimoun forged ahead 50 yards from the tape but in a last desperate effort, Eldon stormed home to a win that prevented the Frenchman from being the only man to score five victories.
